name: scan-to-data
title: ScanToData
description: Camera or photo becomes structured data (receipt, business card, event, or your own schema) via on-device OCR and the local model.

budget.strategy: OCR text (not the image) goes to the model; fields refined deterministically.

docs: Pass `ocr` (e.g. @react-native-ml-kit/text-recognition or Apple Vision) to read photos; without it the component explains that OCR is not configured.
